Two labourers electrocuted while digging sewer pit in Faridabad

Two labourers died from electrocution while digging a sewer pit in Faridabad. The incident occurred when they came into contact with a live wire. A case has been registered against the house owner and the contractor involved in the work. The Print reported the incident, identifying the victims as labourers. The Times of India also reported the electrocution of two individuals digging a pit, noting that a case was filed against the house owner and contractor.
